page.layout: One printed page of running text, one column, with a running head at the top and the page number beside it. Below the text: the word FINIS. No marginal notes. Faint show-through from the facing page at the right edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Quod etiam Horatius vitiorum acerrimus castigator & censor carminibus suis de victu moderato verius, quâ vel vllus Philosophus, vel Medicus, vel Theologus expressit, libr.II. serm.satyr.2.

Remitto etiam auditorem vel lectorem ad Satyram, quam scripsit Varro de cibis & lautitiis, in qua versibus comprehendit exquisitas delitias, & quae helluones terra mariq; conquirunt, pleraq; exposuit, generaque & nomina eduliorum, sicut & domicilia ciborum vt monstrosa, sic pernitiosa exprobrans recenset.

page.notes: The ink circle below FINIS is a stamp or stain, not transcribed. The printed text is set in a larger type than usual, and the line "Quod etiam Horatius" is set without a visible indent. Some letters are uncertain due to the scan: "vllus" and "exquisitas" are read as printed.
